Chapter 6178: An Overlord

Chapter 6178: An Overlord

Others exchanged glances, wondering what a direct disciple of Moshi would look like. Just a self-proclaimed outer disciple was strong enough to guard Sin for eras.

Of course, those aware of more information knew he was being unduly humble. Moreover, after Moshi’s death, Dingtian and Poye also came to Sin and helped train him.

This was the reason why he maintained his grasp over Sin. After all, other primal ancestors had appeared in Sin including Six-sense Ancestor.

Other primal ancestors have descended to Sin; the same was true for some supreme overlords. However, they came and left quickly for various reasons.

“Start.” Li Qiye waved.

“Yes.” Immortal Suppressor took a deep breath and was eager to fight.

Once he accepted death, he looked even more imposing than sitting on the lotus throne. His eyes lit up like stars, commanding respect.

None was able to stop his advance. Those who opposed him faced certain death. Apex and limit emperors stood no chance against him. His unbeatable demeanor returned in full view.

“This is the real Immortal Suppressor.” A spectator said.

Li Qiye was simply too dominating and made him look pathetic in comparison. However, his attitude changed entirely so his confidence returned.

“He’s not weak, Li Qiye is just too strong.” An apex emperor whispered.

“Go!” Immortal Suppressor roared and the cauldron activated.

A boundless epoch appeared with numerous supreme existences. Chaos energy coiled around him, boosting his power.

“Boom!” The epoch fully manifested into reality, containing the might of time and life forces. Figures of supreme overlords could be seen.

Immortal Suppressor joined this dimension, becoming its lord with the cauldron in his grasp. With a temporal stream coursing around him, he became eternal. The images of overlords posed behind him, blessing him with their power.

The cauldron made the whole epoch belong to him. Its fortunes and karmas were his to command.

“The overlord stage!” Apex emperors could no longer withstand the innate pressure emanating from him.

Sin seemed tiny in comparison.

“He’s an overlord now.” Everyone shuddered.

“I could push a primal ancestor back, but not this overlord form.” Chu Zhu took a deep breath.

As a limit path emperor, she could muster enough strength to deliver a move at the primal level. There was hope to win against him.

However, this form granted by the cauldron was something beyond them entirely. Emperors were nothing before an overlord.

“So this is why no one could beat him.” An ambitious and proud emperor said. He once harbored hope of defeating Immortal Suppressor after obtaining a primal anima. Alas, becoming a primal ancestor turned out to be insufficient.

Some emperors and desolate gods thought they had a chance of becoming a primal ancestor but didn’t dare to think about the next realm.

After all, only a few beings in Three Immortals became overlords. For example, Lord of Life and Death, Li Xingchen, Lord of Calamities, Xian Chengtian, Bodhi Ancestor, or Zhan Sansheng’s direct disciple Weizhen…

The only one in Sin who had a chance was the late Transcendent Emperor. Moreover, it was only a chance, not absolute certainty.

“This is more like it but unfortunately, you didn’t comprehend it yourself or you would have a chance with the oblivion process.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, and I only made it this far with Master’s help. My inability tarnishes his name.” Immortal Suppressor sighed.
